gotchas: SkyMiles join form at https://www.delta.com/joinskymiles/ (reached from the header 'Sign Up' link). Old URLs /profile/enrolllanding.action and /us/en/skymiles/join-skymiles are 404s.
A 'Language Selection' dialog covers the page on first load and intercepts clicks; pick a locale (e.g. 'Switzerland - English') first.

Stepped accordion form: 'Basic Info' -> Next -> 'Contact Info' -> 'Login Info', then Terms and Conditions. Only Basic Info is rendered until Next is clicked, so the email, username and password selectors of the later steps were not observed.

Basic Info requires name exactly as on government ID, Date of Birth as three custom comboboxes (Month MM / Date DD / Year YYYY, not native selects) and a custom Gender combobox; Middle Name is optional and a suffix is behind '+ Add Suffix'. Advance with button:has-text("Next").
Basic Info DOB comboboxes: Month options are 'Jan'..'Dec', Date options '1'..'31'; Gender option 'Female'. Then Next.

Contact Info: all fields required. Set Country/Region (custom combobox, defaults to the locale's country) BEFORE the address fields. State/Province is a custom combobox. Confirm Email Address is input[aria-label="Confirm Email Address"]. The phone box wants the national number (phone_national), with the calling code in the separate Country/Region Code combobox.
Address Line 1 validation refused a 49-character street line (aria-invalid, no visible maxlength cut).
